task_objective: Implement the workspace-persistence plan: durable catalog restoration, editor draft and SQL-file persistence, and searchable, pinnable query history.
tests_added: Catalog-store atomic round trips, malformed-entry isolation, corruption tolerance, and interrupted-write preservation.
Unavailable catalog entries, restoration, projection-idempotent persistence, and reinspection of only available sources.
Editor draft restoration, SQL open/save/save-as routing, dirty state, and a two-window catalog persistence round trip using a tmp_path store.
History filtering that persists across refreshes, v2 pinned-field migration, pin persistence, pin-cap retention, and pinned-first sorting under both orders.
design_decisions: Catalog persistence stores only reconstruction fields; schema and profile remain derived and are reinspected after restoration.
Catalog persistence listeners compare the persisted projection before writing, preventing derived schema/profile notifications from rewriting disk state.
Pinned records are intentionally exempt from the normal cap; all pinned records and the 100 newest unpinned records are retained.
Pinned history rows display a leading pin marker and remain above unpinned rows for ascending and descending sorts.
